paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Electric Power Association has scheduled a power outage affecting Prewett Road and Hidden Creek on Tuesday, Oct. 27, from 8:30 to 11:30 a.m.

PEPA announced the planned interruption Sunday, Oct. 25. The scheduled window spans three hours; the cooperative’s notice does not give a reason for the outage or say how many customers will be affected. Its original announcement is linked below.
